assessment.target_route: Supply XML_PARSE_DTDVALID | XML_PARSE_NO_XXE in the first four bytes, followed by an encoded main XML entity containing an internal DTD and a SystemID. The pull route passes its decoded options to xmlCtxtReadMemory.
assessment.failure_condition: The target unconditionally clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID, so no input requests validation on that route.
assessment.alternative_paths: The complete target passes the same masked options to pull parsing, push option setup, and reader creation, and makes no separate validation request. DTDLOAD and NOENT do not set the validation bit.

necessity_evidence.reason: The source supports requesting DTD validation with XML_PARSE_NO_XXE, but the target clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID before passing options to every parser route.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: First four bytes: 00 80 00 10 (XML_PARSE_DTDVALID | XML_PARSE_NO_XXE). Next four: 00 00 04 00 (allocation limit 1024 when the input exceeds 924 bytes). Then encode the first URL and entity as `doc.xml\n` and `<!DOCTYPE r SYSTEM "missing.dtd" [<!ELEMENT r EMPTY>]><r/>\n`, followed by enough trailing bytes to exceed 924 total bytes. The first entity is the main document; the target still clears the validation bit.
